bricks.description: ENVIRONMENT: a narrow wet asphalt alley at night after steady rain, dark brick and shuttered storefronts on both sides, shallow puddles reflecting blurred distant signage, damp fire-escape shadows and mist near the streetlights; atmospheric depth with little clutter.
bricks.when: A noir story, a chase, a goodbye in the rain.

bricks.description: ENVIRONMENT: an empty underground metro platform late at night, long tiled walls and columns receding into the distance, cold fluorescent light, a polished floor reflecting it, no crowd.
ENVIRONMENT: a flat city rooftop at night with an old water tower and antennas, the city lights spread below to the horizon, a hazy orange sky glow, wind and open space.
bricks.when: Freedom, a promise, looking at the city.

bricks.description: ENVIRONMENT: a small laundromat open late, rows of round washing-machine doors, flat fluorescent light, a plastic chair, the dark street visible through the big window.
bricks.when: An ordinary night, a small sadness.

bricks.description: ENVIRONMENT: the concrete underside of a city overpass at night, heavy pillars, sodium-vapour light, graffiti on the walls and cars passing above as streaks of light.
bricks.when: For the street, rap, a hard place.
